subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Auditor's Role and Limits
description: A quick win: understand The Auditor's Role and Limits.

hook.text: Arthur Andersen audited both Enron and WorldCom. Both were massive frauds. The auditor caught neither.

buildup.text: Auditors verify financial statements but are hired and paid by the company they audit. The conflict is obvious.

discovery.text: Audit firms earn more from consulting than auditing. Challenging clients risks losing lucrative non-audit fees.

twist.text: After Enron, SOX separated audit and consulting. But the Big Four still dominate both services.

climax.text: Auditors provide reasonable assurance, not certainty. They check samples, not every transaction.

punchline.text: The auditor is paid by the client. Independence has limits.

quiz.question: Why is auditor independence a concern?
options: Auditors are paid by the companies they audit
